{"name":"ConvaiToolset.ConvaiActionToolset","version":"1.0","description":"Convai action toolset: declares actions on a chatbot and synthesizes the
Blueprint event handlers that respond to them. Together these let an agent
stand up the Convai "action" affordance loop without touching the graph by hand.","tools":[{"description":"Synthesizes a Convai action handler in a Blueprint's event graph.

Creates a Custom Event named EXACTLY ActionName with a single input pin of type
FConvaiResultAction, and wires its exec output to a HandleActionCompletion call
on the Blueprint's chatbot component (auto-wiring the chatbot self pin from the
component variable when present). This is the runtime contract that
UConvaiChatbotComponent::TriggerNamedBlueprintAction expects. The Blueprint is
compiled. Replicates the core of ConvaiCreateActionHandlerSpawner WITHOUT any
modal dialog.","name":"ConvaiToolset.ConvaiActionToolset.CreateConvaiActionHandler","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"blueprintPath":{"type":"string","description":"Object path of the Blueprint to add the handler to."},"actionName":{"type":"string","description":"The exact action name; the created Custom Event is named the same."}},"required":["blueprintPath","actionName"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"The created event name on success, or an error string prefixed with "Error:"."}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"Appends a parameterized action to a chatbot's Environment action list.

Locates the BP_ConvaiChatbotComponent (or any UConvaiChatbotComponent) on the
given Blueprint, enables EnvironmentData.bEnableActions, and adds an
FConvaiAction named ActionName (with the given Description and parameters),
preserving any existing actions. A same-named action is replaced in place.
The Blueprint is compiled and saved.

Note: these actions take effect at the next chatbot /connect — they prepare the
NEXT session, they don't mutate a live one.","name":"ConvaiToolset.ConvaiActionToolset.AddConvaiAction","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"characterBlueprintPath":{"type":"string","description":"Object path of the Blueprint that owns the chatbot component."},"actionName":{"type":"string","description":"Canonical action name, e.g. "Wave", "Pick Up", "Say". Should match the handler event name."},"description":{"type":"string","description":"Optional human-language description of what the action does."},"parameters":{"type":"array","items":{"title":"ConvaiToolsetActionParam","type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","description":"Placeholder name as the LLM sees it, e.g. "text", "destination", "time in seconds"."},"description":{"type":"string","description":"Optional human-language description of what the parameter means. May be empty."},"type":{"type":"string","title":"EConvaiActionParamType","enum":["Auto","Reference","String","Number","Bool","Enum"],"description":"How the value is interpreted. Use String for free text, Number for numerics,
Reference to resolve against the chatbot's known Objects/Characters, Bool for
true/false, Enum for a fixed choice set, or Auto (default) to infer at parse time."},"choices":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"For a FIXED choice-set parameter, list the allowed values here and use Type=String (this mirrors
the built-in "Move" action's `direction` param: String + choices). AddConvaiAction cannot supply
a UEnum, so a Type=Enum param is coerced to String — put the options in Choices so the LLM sees
them as "{name [a|b|c]: string}". Leave empty for free-form params."}},"required":["name","description","type","choices"]},"description":"Ordered list of declared parameters (name + type) the LLM should fill in."}},"required":["characterBlueprintPath","actionName","description","parameters"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"A human-readable status string describing what was changed."}},"required":["returnValue"]}}]}
